name: Gaya
scopeLimits: The official BhuNaksha client exposes parcel maps as WMS imagery and plot selection/detail routes, but no public full-geometry vector endpoint was identified. WMS tiles and plot-detail routes were not queried for parcel records. The WUP locator is a settlement centroid, not a parcel identity or city boundary. No owner/address/rights-holder data or credentials were retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official Gaya district land-records page points users to Bihar land-record services, and the Bihar BhuNaksha public map exposes the district/subdivision/circle/mauza/survey hierarchy. This confirms local records and parcel-map indexing for Gaya, but not anonymous full-vector access.

officialSources.observation: Official Gaya district land-records page provides the local government land-record service entry point.
Official Bihar Revenue Department portal links revenue land records and cadastral map services.

Public Bihar BhuNaksha map shell has district, subdivision, circle, mauza and survey/map selectors. Client JavaScript uses WMS imagery and plot-selection/detail routes; no full geometry response was requested or returned.

viewerAndServiceTrace.notes: Inspected public client JS/config. WMS is imagery, while selected-plot routes are not a documented geometry-only vector response; they were not called. No polygon retained.
